blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Probing studies of latent reasoning often read a model's state where the answer begins and take a failed probe as evidence that a value is absent. We test this with a digit copied from the question, in the looped model Ouro-1.4B and the standard transformer Qwen2.5-1.5B. Comparing prompts that differ only in that digit shows it is present at the last prompt token, in a code shared across questions (readout about 0.9). A probe that sees one prompt at a time, the usual setting, barely reads it: 0.36 in Ouro and 0.19 in Qwen even after 5,249 training questions. The digit's change is small rather than crowded: random noise lands on equally busy directions, while a random word in its place moves the state far more and is readable. Since every varied token leaves a trace, a successful probe is ambiguous too. We give a protocol, including a synthetic null for generic mixing, for testing computed values against copies and mixtures of the inputs. In pre-registered studies of two-step problems it finds a small signal for the unwritten intermediate a+b just before Ouro writes the answer's last digit, and its sign follows the operation, though mixing alone produces much of that sign-following part. Holding that value at another problem's from the first loop on does not move the written digit toward the other problem's, while the same patch of the answer does: the value is readable but not used.
blocks.zh: 对潜伏推理的探险研究经常读到模型的状态,即答案的开始,并将失败的探测器作为缺少一个值的证据. 我们用从问题中复制出来的数字测试这个,在环绕的型号Ouro-1.4B和标准变压器Quen2.5-1.5B中. 比较不同的提示,仅以数字表示,在最后一个提示符上,用一个跨问题共享的代码(读出约0.9)。 一个每次看到一个提示的探测器, 通常的设定, 几乎没有读到它: 0.36 in Ouro, 0.19 in Quen 即使在5,249个训练问题之后。 数位的变化是小的而不是拥挤的:随机的噪声降落在同样繁忙的方向上,而一个随机的单词在它的位置上移动的状态要多得多,并且可以读取. 由于每个不同的符物都会留下痕迹,成功的探测器也模糊不清. 我们给出一项协议,包括用于一般混合的合成无效物,用于对照输入物的副本和混合物测试计算值。 在对两步问题的预先注册研究中,它发现在Ouro写下答案的最后一位数字之前,未写成的中间体a+b有一个小信号,它的标志随操作而来,尽管单独混合产生大部分的符号跟随部分. 将这个值保存在第一个循环上的另一个问题上并不能使写数向另一个问题上移动,而同一补丁的答案是:该值是可读的,但没有使用。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Looped transformers apply one block of layers repeatedly ( Geiping et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) , and one hope is that the extra loops work as a hidden chain of thought. Two kinds of evidence are used to test this: accuracy without written steps should rise with the number of loops, and the values the model works with should be readable from its states. For Huginn, Lu et al. (2025) found neither. Its answer-only GSM8K accuracy stayed at 3–5% across recurrence counts, and a logit lens showed no intermediate values. For Ouro-1.4B, accuracy alone cannot settle the question. Answering directly after the question, its GSM8K accuracy rises from 6.5% after one loop to 23% after four, but almost all of the gain comes at loop 2, where Ouro also improves on benchmarks that need no reasoning (Appendix A ). To see whether the loops compute intermediate values, one has to look inside.
blocks.zh: 循环变压器反复地应用一块地层(Geiping等,2025;Zhu等,2025),一个希望是外环作为隐藏的思想链发挥作用. 用两种证据来检验这一点:没有书面步骤的准确性应该随着环数的增加而上升,模型工作所用的值应该从其状态读取. 对于Huginn,Lu等人(2025年)都没有发现. 其只答的GSM8K精度在整个重现计数中保持在3–5%,一个对数镜头没有显示中间值. 对Ouro-1.4B来说,光靠准确性不能解决问题. 在直接回答问题后,它的GSM8K精度从一圈后6.5%上升到四圈后23%,但几乎所有增益都来自二圈,Ouro也改进了不需要推理的基准(附录A. 要了解循环是否计算中间值,必须先看看内部.

blocks.en: Probing studies of latent reasoning read the state at the position where the answer begins, which we call the summary position, and interpret failed readouts as evidence against latent intermediate values ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Yu, 2024 ) . Looking inside this way runs into a problem that is not specific to looped models: at the summary position, a standard linear probe barely reads even a digit copied from the question. We find: • The digit is present but hard to read (Sections 3.1 and 3.2 ). Minimal pairs, prompts that differ in a single token, show that it is there in both Ouro and Qwen2.5-1.5B, in a code shared across questions. A probe that compares a question’s ten variants reads it at about 0.9. A probe that sees a single prompt, as probing studies do, reads it at 0.12–0.24 with tens of training templates, and more than 5,000 distinct training questions lift it only to 0.36 in Ouro and 0.19 in Qwen (Figure 2 ). The two probes answer different questions, whether the digit is there and what it is in a new prompt, and here the answers come apart. A failed probe at such a position says little about whether a copied value is there. • The change is small, not crowded (Section 3.3 ). The digit’s directions are as busy as those of any change at that token, random noise included. What differs is size: a random word in the digit’s place moves the state far more and is readable, while random noise whose variants start as far apart as the words’ arrives as small as the digit. A pre-registered follow-up finds that this is not a matter of linear gain: what reaches the last token depends on which token is present. • A protocol for computed values (Section 4 ). Every varied token, needed or not, leaves a trace, so a successful probe says little more than a failed one. The protocol compares a candidate value with what copies of the inputs allow, ranks it against every combination of the inputs at a prime modulus, and compares it with its sign-flipped twin, with mixtures of the output being written, and with what generic mixing produces in synthetic states. • What it finds in Ouro (Section 5 ). In three pre-registered studies of two-step problems, a small, sign-specific signal for the unwritten a + b a+b appears just before the answer’s last digit, and when the operation is swapped, the better-read sign follows it. As a label, a + b a+b is the same as the answer plus c c , the answer is readable as early, and synthetic states that only mix the inputs with the answer give about half the signal, so it may be largely such a mixture. Replacing that value with another problem’s does not move the digit Ouro writes toward the other problem’s, even when it is held fixed from the first loop on, while the same patch of the answer does: at that position the value is readable but not used. Appendix C gives the status of every analysis, including which were pre-registered.

blocks.en: 2 Setup
blocks.zh: 2 设置

blocks.en: Ouro-1.4B ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) runs its 24 layers up to four times. We read its state at the middle (after layer 12) and at the end of each loop, in fp32. Nothing is trained, and on check prompts our forward pass matches Ouro’s own with a largest absolute logit difference of 0. Qwen2.5-1.5B ( Qwen Team, 2024 ) is a standard 28-layer transformer; we read its states after layers 4, 7, 14, 21 and 28. Both models give each digit its own token. Every prompt starts with the same four GSM8K training problems ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , the first four of the training set, each followed directly by its final answer, then the test question and “Answer:”. A problem counts as solved if every token of the gold answer is the model’s top prediction and the next predicted token does not continue the number.
blocks.zh: 欧罗1.4B (Zhu等,2025年)运行其24层可达4次. 我们在中间(第12层之后)和每个循环的结尾,用fp32读取它的状态. 没有任何人受过训练, 文2.5-1.5B (中文(简体) ). (Quen Team, 2024 )是一个标准的28层变压器;我们在4,7,14,21和28层后读取它的状态. 两个型号都给每个位数自己的代号. 每一次快速开始相同的4个GSM8K训练问题(Cobbe等,2021年),训练集的前4个,每组直接接上最后的答案,再接上测试问题和"答: 如果每个金子答案的符号都是模型的顶级预测,而下一个预测的符号不继续数字,那么问题就算解决了。

blocks.en: The standard probe standardizes the state, projects it onto 256 principal components fitted on the training folds, and fits a multinomial logistic regression whose regularization ( C ∈ { 0.01 , 0.1 , 1 } C\in\{0.01,0.1,1\} , or a constant majority guess) is chosen by an inner 3-fold cross-validation. It is scored on 5 held-out folds grouped by template, so it must generalize to unseen kinds of problem. The minimal-pair probe (Section 3.1 ) is the same probe on states from which each family’s mean has been subtracted. Labels are units digits. We probe two positions: P0, the last prompt token, and, in Sections 4 and 5 , P1, the answer token just before its units digit, with the gold answer fed in.
blocks.zh: 标准探测器将状态标准化,将其投射到256个主要部件上,安装在训练花架上,并适合一个多名后勤回归,其规范化(C {{ 0.01, 0.1, 1} C\in 0.01, 0.1, 1\}, 或恒定多数猜想)由内三倍的交叉验证选择. 它被分到5个按模板排列的被搁置的折叠上,所以它必须被概括到隐蔽的问题类型. 最小平面探测器(第3.1节)是对每个家庭的平均值被减去的状态的同一探测器。 标签是单位数字。 我们探测出两个位置:P0,最后一个即时信号,在第4和5节中,P1,在单位数之前的答案信号,黄金答案输入。

blocks.en: 3 A copied digit is present but hard to read
blocks.zh: 3个 复制的位数存在, 但很难读取

blocks.en: 3.1 Minimal pairs find what a standard probe misses
blocks.zh: 3.1 最小对子发现标准探测器错过了什么

blocks.en: A standard probe at the last prompt token does not read a digit copied from the question. In a pre-registered study of intermediate values, its sanity check, the last digit of the largest number in the question, scored 40.8%, exactly the rate of always guessing the most common digit. By position, the probe reads a copied digit perfectly on its own token, about half the time one token later (early in the first loop only), and at chance from three tokens on, consistent with the rapid loss of earlier-token information found at the last token of multi-token words in other models ( Feucht et al., 2024 ) . In bare questions such as “What is 247 plus 580?” the same probe reads both operands at the last token at 0.96–1.00, but those prompts differ only in their numbers, which makes them close to minimal pairs.
blocks.zh: 最后一个快取符的标准探测器不会读取问题复制的位数. 在预先注册的中间值研究中,它的灵敏度检查,即问题中最大数字中的最后一位数字,得分为40.8%,恰好是总是猜测最常见数字的速度. 按位置,探测器在自有符上完美地读出一个被复制的位数,大约一半的时间是后期一个符上(早于第一个回环上),偶然地从三个符上取出,这与在其他模型中多趾词最后一个符上发现的更早被复制的信息迅速丢失是一致的(Feucht等,2024年). 在诸如“247+580是什么?” 这样的空洞问题中,同一探测器在最后一点读取了0.96-1.00的两种操作符,但这些提示符只在其数量上有所不同,因此接近于最小的对。

blocks.en: We took one question per template and one of its multi-digit numbers, and made ten copies that differ only in that number’s last digit (0–9): 137 such families from 77 distinct questions, one per template (a template’s two families vary different numbers of the same question). The copies are identical token for token except one, so any difference in a later state is caused by that digit. Counterfactual minimal pairs are a standard interpretability control ( Stolfo et al., 2023 ; Vig et al., 2020 ) ; subtracting a family’s mean removes what the family shares, the contrast that difference-in-means probing uses to find a direction ( Marks & Tegmark, 2023 ) . We then repeated the test with an added sentence that cannot matter (“Unrelated fact: a nearby park has 43 benches.”), varying either its number or a colour word (“43 red benches”). Table 1 and Figure 1 give the results in Ouro.
blocks.zh: 我们每模板一个问题和一个多位数字,并做了十份,只有该数字的最后一位数字(0–9)不同:137个这样的家庭与77个不同的问题,每个模板一个(一个模板的两个家庭就同一个问题的不同数字)不同。 拷贝是除一外的同一种令牌,所以后一状态的任何区别都是由该位数造成的. 反事实最小对是标准可解释性控制(Stolfo等,2023;Vig等,2020;减去一个家庭的平均值去除这个家庭的股分,这个对比是用不同的方法来寻找方向(Marks & Tegmark,2023). 然后,我们重复了试验,增加了一句,这句无关紧要(“不相关的事实:附近的公园有43个长凳......”),其数目或彩色词(“43个红色长凳”)。 表1和图1列出了Ouo的成绩。

blocks.en: Every varied token reaches the position where the answer begins, and the minimal-pair probe reads it on templates it never saw. Any changed input leaves some change in later states; what matters is that this one is in a code shared across questions, which a probe trained on other templates reads. The code is shared: a probe trained on needed numbers reads irrelevant ones at 0.78–0.97. The irrelevant number almost never changes the first token of Ouro’s answer (at most 2.6% of families), so the trace is the copied token, not the answer in progress; this fits GSM-NoOp, where an irrelevant clause lowers accuracy ( Mirzadeh et al., 2024 ) , although we did not test whether the trace causes errors. The code is not a magnitude direction ( Zhu et al., 2024 ) , consistent with per-digit codes ( Levy & Geva, 2025 ) : a linear value component exists ( R 2 R^{2} 0.57), but the probe’s errors are no closer to the true digit than random guesses (mean distance 3.8 against 3.7), and the top one to four principal components read the digit at only 0.21–0.45, against 0.93–0.97 with 256. It behaves like a code for which token was there, as the colour result suggests. A shared code is what copying predicts, since an attention head that moves a token writes roughly the same vector for it whatever the context; binding vectors that transfer across tasks have been found the same way ( Feng & Steinhardt, 2024 ) . The minimal-pair probe needs all ten variants of a question, so it is a test for presence, not a decoder.

blocks.en: A pre-registered study repeated these measurements in Qwen2.5-1.5B with the same families, prompt, probes and code. Its rule called the result a replication if, at the last prompt token over layers 7–28, the minimal-pair probe averaged at least 0.80, while the standard probe stayed at or below 0.30, a structured decoder at or below 0.40, and the gain from half to all training templates at or below 0.05. It is a replication (Table 2 ). The structured decoder is the best linear decoder we could build for single prompts: a mass-mean probe ( Marks & Tegmark, 2023 ) built from the minimal-pair digit means and a shrunk estimate of the covariance of training prompts around them. It reads no better than the standard probe, and neither does a small MLP, nor, in Ouro, the probe without its PCA step. If the context were Gaussian with the covariance estimated from the training templates, the same decoder would read 0.53–0.92; the gap means that new templates move the state along directions the training templates did not. The claim is about decoders trained without the test question: if the covariance also includes the test question’s other variants, a single prompt reads at about 0.9, which amounts to subtracting the family mean.

blocks.en: These data hold only 77 distinct questions, which leaves room for a probe that simply needs more of them. In two further pre-registered studies, one per model, we gave the model one prompt for each of 6,249 GSM8K training questions, with the units digit of the last number of two or more digits set at random, held out a fixed 1,000, and trained probes on nested subsets of the rest (Figure 2 ). Minimal pairs on 150 (Qwen) and 100 (Ouro) of the held-out questions, with folds by question, read the digit at 0.91 and 0.96. Single prompts stay far below. At 5,249 training questions, 7–39 times the number of components that hold 95% of the states’ variance, the best probe, a logistic regression on the full state with its regularization inside the grid, reads 0.19 in Qwen and 0.36 in Ouro; a small MLP reads 0.11–0.14 and 0.16–0.24. Both curves are still rising. By the pre-registered rule Qwen’s is partial (+0.044 over the last doubling) and Ouro’s climbs (+0.060, above the rule’s 0.05, though the level stays below its 0.50). The minimal pairs do not solve the single-prompt task more cheaply: they see all ten variants of the test question, so they show that the digit is present, not what it is in a new prompt. What the gap shows is that presence and single-prompt readability come apart, by a wide margin even after thousands of training questions. Why Ouro’s probe climbs faster than Qwen’s is open.

blocks.en: 3.3 A small change, not a crowded one
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 一个小变化,不是拥挤的

blocks.en: A trace at a few percent of the variance would still be easy to read if questions hardly varied along its directions. They vary a lot. Take the digit’s directions to be the 9-dimensional span of the family-centred digit means, and its overlap to be the context’s variance per dimension inside that span over its average per dimension. The overlap is 6.5–11.7 in Ouro and 15–24 in Qwen, so within its own subspace the digit’s signal is at most a few percent of the variance around it (Ouro by state in Appendix B ). The overlap is not specific to the digit. A subspace fitted with the digit labels shuffled within each family, which carries no shared code, has about the same (ratio 0.83 in Ouro and 1.01 in Qwen), and a colour word and a number varied in the added sentence are each about as crowded as their own shuffled-label baselines, or less. Any change within a question lands on the directions along which questions vary most.
blocks.zh: 如果问题沿其方向几乎没有变化,那么追踪差异的几分之一仍然容易读取。 它们差异很大。 以数字为方向,成为以家庭为中心的数字的9个维相间,其重叠性是背景内每个维相间的相差超过每个维相间的平均数。 重叠在Ouro和Quen分别是6.5–11.7和15–24,因此在自己的子空间内,数字的信号最多是周围差异的几分之数(附录B按状态列出的Ouro)。 重叠并不针对数字。 配有每个家族内部所打的数位标签的子空间,没有共享代码,该子空间大约相同(Ouro 0.83和Quen 1.01),所添加的句子中一个颜色单词和数字相去甚远的都像自己的被打出标签的基线一样拥挤,或者更少. 问题中的任何变化都发生在问题变化最大的方向上。

blocks.en: What differs between changes is their size (Table 3 ). In Qwen we also replaced the digit with one of ten random words, or added one of ten random vectors of a typical token embedding’s size to its embedding. All three changes land on equally busy directions: by the pre-registered measure, the word swap’s overlap is 0.89 times the digit’s and the noise’s 1.07. Their signal-to-noise inside their own subspaces differs by orders of magnitude, and readability follows it: a standard probe reads the word swap at 0.24–0.74, and the digit and the noise at 0.11–0.15. The input embeddings show where part of the difference starts. In both models the ten digits sit about half as far apart as random words do (0.70 against 1.37 in Qwen, 0.88 against 1.54 in Ouro). But the start does not explain all of it: the word and noise variants start equally far apart, and only the word change reaches the last token, while the noise arrives as small as the digit or smaller. These comparisons are descriptive. A pre-registered follow-up measured the linear response of the last token to small changes at the digit’s input embedding (Appendix B ). To first order, the last token is about as sensitive to random input directions as to directions in which token embeddings differ (gain ratio 1.2–1.5), and the word swap’s effect is almost entirely nonlinear: its linear prediction is orthogonal to the actual change and 4.5–15 times too small. What reaches the last token depends on which token is present, not on how far the input moves. Small changes along digit directions are even carried more strongly than along word directions (3–8 times, to first order), so the digit’s small trace goes with swapping one digit for another, a smaller change in kind than swapping in a word. Which mechanism carries a token’s identity to the last token is open.

blocks.en: This is not superposition in the usual sense ( Elhage et al., 2022 ) : the digit shares its directions with the variation between contexts, not with a fixed set of other features. Probing work usually asks whether a probe’s success reflects the representation or the probe’s capacity ( Hewitt & Liang, 2019 ) ; here a probe fails because a signal shared across contexts is small next to the variation the contexts add along the same directions, and only the minimal-pair contrast removes that variation. The same limit is known from population coding in neuroscience, where only noise along the signal’s own direction limits a decoder ( Moreno-Bote et al., 2014 ) .

blocks.en: 3.4 What this means for probing
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 这对调查意味着什么?

blocks.en: A probe that fails at a summary position is weak evidence that a copied value is absent: in Ouro and in Qwen, a digit that is demonstrably present reads at most 0.24 with tens of training templates, and at most 0.36 after 5,000 training questions. A probe that succeeds is weak evidence of computation: every token we varied, including an irrelevant number and a colour word, leaves a trace in the same position, so a probe that reads a “computed” value may be reading the copied inputs it is a function of. Computed values may be encoded differently; we did not test whether the same gap holds for them. The second problem is the one Section 4 addresses.
blocks.zh: 一个在汇总位置上失败的探测器是缺乏复制值的薄弱证据:在Ouro和Quen中,一个明显存在的数字读取最多为0.24分并有数十个训练模板,在5000个训练问题后读取最多为0.36分. 成功的探测器是计算中的薄弱证据:我们所改变的每一个符号,包括一个不相关的数字和一个颜色词,都在同一位置留下了痕迹,因此读取一个“计算”值的探测器可能正在读取它所完成的复制输入。 计算出的数值可能编码不同;我们没有测试它们是否有相同的漏洞。 第二个问题是第4节所涉及的一个问题。

blocks.en: 4 A protocol for computed values
blocks.zh: 页:1 计算值的协议

blocks.en: Within a minimal-pair family one digit varies, so any computed value is a fixed function of that digit, and a probe that reads it could be reading the copy. The fix is a factorial design: vary the operands’ units digits together, with everything else fixed (a family fixes the template, names and tens digits), and probe for a combination such as ( a + b ) mod 5 (a+b)\bmod 5 . Like XOR, such a combination cannot be read linearly from separate traces of a a and b b : if the state holds f ⁡ ( a ) + g ⁡ ( b ) f(a)+g(b) , a linear probe on it does no better than the same probe on one-hot codes of the digits, since any function of a digit is linear in its one-hot code. We call that probe’s accuracy the copy ceiling , and measure every label as its excess over its own ceiling. Excess alone shows that the operands were combined, not that the needed value was computed: a state can mix its inputs in a generic, non-additive way, which makes many combinations readable. The protocol therefore compares the target with the alternatives a generic mixture would also make readable: 1. Copy ceiling. Measure every label against the same probe on one-hot copies of the inputs, a conditional probe with the inputs as its baseline ( Hewitt et al., 2021 ) , adding any input-derived quantity the model can see. In our studies that is the answer digit already written, and, as a stricter case, the carry and borrow. 2. A prime modulus. Mod 10, many combinations share their odd/even half with a + b a+b or with the answer digit, including a − b a-b and every form on the line answer + k ​ c +\,kc , so a state that holds either gives those controls free accuracy. In a synthetic check where the state held only the copies and the answer digit, a + b + c a+b+c mod 10 read 0.14 above its ceiling; mod 5, every label stayed within 0.04 of its ceiling. 3. Every combination. Rank the target against all combinations x ​ a + y ​ b + z ​ c xa+yb+zc of the inputs (31 mod 5), not a few chosen controls, since periodic number features ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Kantamneni & Tegmark, 2025 ) can make some combinations easier to read than others. 4. Sign-flipped twins. Compare the target with the same operands under the opposite sign ( a + b a+b against a − b a-b ). A generic mixture has no reason to prefer the needed sign. With a single operation it cannot separate the needed sign from a fixed preference for that sign; swapping the operation can (Section 5.3 ). 5. Mixtures of the output. Compare the target with the other forms on its line through the output being written ( answer + k ​ x \text{answer}+kx for a copied number x x ), and with other forms of the same size. This exposes a state that mixes the output with one input, and one that simply holds two-number mixtures better. The comparison along the line is weak: pairwise mixing favours a two-number target over the three-number forms on its line (Section 5.4 ). The position matters too. Ouro writes a number’s leading digit first, but that digit already depends on the units digits through the carry and the borrow: to write the 4 of 47 in 30 + 30 − 13 30+30-13 , the model must know that 0 + 0 < 3 0+0<3 . A value computed step by step would therefore first be needed at P0, the last prompt token. We probe P0 and P1, the answer token just before the units digit, with the gold answer fed in. P1 is the last point at which the units digit of a + b a+b is needed, and the point where the answer is least latent, since its tens digit has already been written.
blocks.zh: 在一个最小的pair家族中,一个位数不同,所以任何计算值都是该位数的固定函数,读取它的探测器可能是读取副本. 固定是一个因子设计:将操作单位的位数和所有其它固定(一个家族固定模板,名称和数十个位数)一起变化,并探测一个组合,如(a + b) mod 5(a +b)\bmod 5。 和XOR一样,这种组合不能从a和bb的单独痕迹中线性地读取: 如果状态持有 f + g + → (b) f (a) + g (b) ,其上的一个线性探测器不会比同一个探测器在位数的一热码上更好,因为一个位数的任何函数在其一热码中都是线性. 我们称这个探测器的准确性为复制上限, 过度本身就表明操作是合并的,而不是需要的值是计算出来的:一个状态可以以非附加的通用方式混合其输入,这使得许多组合可以读取. 因此,议定书将目标与替代品相提并论。 1. 复制天花板。 在输入的一热拷贝上,用输入作为基线的有条件的探测器(Hewitt等人,2021年)对同一探测器的每个标签进行测量,并添加模型所能看到的任何输入量。 在我们的研究中,这是已经写好的答案,作为一个更严格的例子,就是带和借。 2. 质调. Mod 10,许多组合以+b a+b或与答数共享其奇数/偶数之半,包括一-b a-b和行接答+k c ++\,kc上的每一个表,所以一个状态要么持有,要么赋予这些控件自由精确. 在只持有副本和答案数字的合成检查中,一个+b +c a +b +c mod 10读取其上限上方的0.14;mod 5,每个标签都保留在其上限上方的0.04以内. 3. 每个组合。 将目标排在输入的x a + y b + z c xa+yb+zc上(31 mod 5),并非少数选择的控制,因为周期数特性(周等,2024;Kantamneni & Tegmark,2025)可以使一些组合比其他组合更容易被读取. 4. 有标志的双胞胎。 将目标与反向标志下的同一种操作相比较(一个+b a+b对-b a-b). 一种通用的混合物没有理由更喜欢所需的标志。 单项操作不能将所需标志与对该标志的固定偏好分开;交换操作可以(第5.3节)。 5. 产出的混合。 通过正在写入的输出( 回答 + k x\ text{ sanswer\xxx for a copy number x x) 来比较目标与其行上的其他表单, 并与大小相同的其它表单. 这暴露出一种将输出与一种输入相混合的状态,一种只是把两个数的混合物保存得更好. 沿线的比较很弱:双向混合有利于双数指标,而不是其线上三数表(第5.4节)。 职位也很重要。 Ouro首先写一个数字的头号数字, 但是这个数字已经取决于通过载数和借出数的单位数: 要将47中的4写入30+30−13 30+30-13, 模型必须知道0+0 < 3 0+0 < 3。 因此,首先需要在P0即最后一个即时信号上逐步计算出一个数值。 我们探测了P0和P1, 在单位数之前的答案, 黄金答案被输入。 P1是需要+b a +b 的单位数的最后一点,也是答案最不潜伏的一点,因为其十位数已经写入了.

blocks.en: Copy ceiling. Measure every label against the same probe on one-hot copies of the inputs, a conditional probe with the inputs as its baseline ( Hewitt et al., 2021 ) , adding any input-derived quantity the model can see. In our studies that is the answer digit already written, and, as a stricter case, the carry and borrow.
blocks.zh: 复制天花板。 在输入的一热拷贝上,用输入作为基线的有条件的探测器(Hewitt等人,2021年)对同一探测器的每个标签进行测量,并添加模型所能看到的任何输入量。 在我们的研究中,这是已经写好的答案,作为一个更严格的例子,就是带和借。

blocks.en: A prime modulus. Mod 10, many combinations share their odd/even half with a + b a+b or with the answer digit, including a − b a-b and every form on the line answer + k ​ c +\,kc , so a state that holds either gives those controls free accuracy. In a synthetic check where the state held only the copies and the answer digit, a + b + c a+b+c mod 10 read 0.14 above its ceiling; mod 5, every label stayed within 0.04 of its ceiling.
blocks.zh: 质地模具. Mod 10,许多组合以+b a+b或与答数共享其奇数/偶数之半,包括一-b a-b和行接答+k c ++\,kc上的每一个表,所以一个状态要么持有,要么让这些控制自由准确. 在只持有副本和答案数字的合成检查中,一个+b +c a +b +c mod 10读取其上限上方的0.14;mod 5,每个标签都保留在其上限上方的0.04以内.

blocks.en: Every combination. Rank the target against all combinations x ​ a + y ​ b + z ​ c xa+yb+zc of the inputs (31 mod 5), not a few chosen controls, since periodic number features ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Kantamneni & Tegmark, 2025 ) can make some combinations easier to read than others.
blocks.zh: 每个组合。 将目标排在输入物的x a + y b + z c xa+yb+zc 上(31 mod 5),并非少数选择的控件,因为周期数特性(周等,2024;Kantamneni & Tegmark,2025)可以使一些组合比其他组合更容易被读取.

blocks.en: Sign-flipped twins. Compare the target with the same operands under the opposite sign ( a + b a+b against a − b a-b ). A generic mixture has no reason to prefer the needed sign. With a single operation it cannot separate the needed sign from a fixed preference for that sign; swapping the operation can (Section 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: 签名的双胞胎。 将目标与反向标志下相同的操作(一+b a+b对一-b a-b)进行比较. 一种通用的混合物没有理由更喜欢所需的标志。 单项操作不能将所需标志与对该标志的固定偏好分开;交换操作可以(第5.3节)。

blocks.en: Mixtures of the output. Compare the target with the other forms on its line through the output being written ( answer + k ​ x \text{answer}+kx for a copied number x x ), and with other forms of the same size. This exposes a state that mixes the output with one input, and one that simply holds two-number mixtures better. The comparison along the line is weak: pairwise mixing favours a two-number target over the three-number forms on its line (Section 5.4 ).
blocks.zh: 输出的混合. 通过正在写入的输出( 回答 + k x\ text{ sanswer\xxx for a copy number x x) 来比较目标与其行上的其他表单, 并与大小相同的其它表单. 这暴露出一种将输出与一种输入相混合的状态,一种只是把两个数的混合物保存得更好. 沿线的比较很弱:双向混合有利于双数指标,而不是其线上三数表(第5.4节)。

blocks.en: 5 What the protocol finds in Ouro
blocks.zh: 页:1 协议在Ouo找到什么

blocks.en: 5.1 Two pre-registered studies
blocks.zh: 5.1 联合国 两份预先登记的研究报告

blocks.en: Studies 1 and 2 used two-step word problems whose answer is a + b − c a+b-c , so the intermediate a + b a+b is never written; for example, “Maya has 30 stickers. Her friend gives her 30 more stickers. She then uses 13 stickers on a card. How many stickers does Maya have left?” A study has 12 templates × \times 3 families × \times 200 of the 1,000 unit-digit combinations (7,200 problems), plus bare additions (“What is A plus B?”) with all 100 unit-digit pairs per family. Study 2 used 12 new templates with new wording, objects and names. Both passed their gates: answer-only accuracy after loop 4 was 0.66 and 0.60, the copied digits read at 0.90 or above, and on bare problems the sum’s units digit read 1.00 at P1, where it is Ouro’s next prediction. Intervals are 97.5% (Bonferroni over the two hypotheses) and resample families. Table 4 gives the pre-registered results.
blocks.zh: 研究1和2使用了两步字问题,答案是+b-c+b-c,因此中间的a+b a+b从未被写出;例如"Maya有30个贴子. 她的朋友给她30个贴纸。 然后她在一张卡上用出13个贴纸. 玛雅还剩下多少贴纸? 一项研究有12个模板x\times 3个家庭x\times 1000个单位-数字组合中的200个(7,200个问题),加上赤相加 ("A + B?"),每个家庭所有100个单位-数字对. 研究2使用了12个有新措辞,对象和名称的新模板. 两者都经过了大门:循环4之后的只答精度为0.66和0.60,复制后的数字为0.90或以上,在明显的问题中,总和的单位数字在P1时读为1.00,这是Ouro的下一个预测。 间断为97.5%(Bonferroni 胜于两个假说)和再生家族. 表4列出预先登记的结果。

blocks.en: Table 4: Pre-registered results, after loop 4: excess over the copy ceiling. Study 1 was scored mod 10 against a − b a-b and a + c a+c ; Study 2 mod 5 against a − b a-b , a + c a+c and two mixtures of the answer with c c .
blocks.zh: 表4:在循环4之后预先登记的结果:超过副本上限。 研究1的分数为:Mod 10对一-b a-b和一+c a+c;研究2 mod 5对一-b a-b,一+c a+c,以及答案与c的两种混合物.

blocks.en: Study 1’s controls did not include combinations of the answer digit with c c ; since a + b = answer + c a+b=\text{answer}+c , a state holding the answer and a copy of c c could make a + b a+b readable without any intermediate. Study 2 added those controls and moved to mod 5. Before the answer starts, at P0, a + b a+b is not readable in either study; Study 3 returns to P0. In bare addition, the apparent sum before writing is generic mixing: with controls, a − b a-b reads better than a + b a+b (Figure 3 , left).
blocks.zh: 研究1的控件不包括回答数字与c-的组合;因为一个+b=回答+c a+b=\text{answer}+c],一个持有答案的状态和一个c的拷贝可以在没有任何中间点的情况下使一个+b a+b读取. 研究2增加了这些控制并移至了mod 5. 在回答开始前,在P0, a + b a +b 时,任一研究都不可读; 第3研究返回到P0. 此外,在写作前的明显总和是通用的混合:与控件相配合,a-b a-b读取优于a-b a-b+b (图3,左出).

blocks.en: Figure 3: Study 2, after loop 4, mod 5: excess of the minimal-pair probe over each label’s copy ceiling. Left: bare addition at the last prompt token. Right: word problems at P1, just before the answer’s units digit.
blocks.zh: 图3:研究2,循环4后,mod 5:每个标签的复制天花板上超过最小平板探测器. 左: 在最后的提示上添加赤色 。 右: P1 的单词问题, 在答题单位数之前 。

blocks.en: 5.2 Sign flips and every combination
blocks.zh: 5.2 签名翻转和每个组合

blocks.en: The analyses in this subsection were run after the two studies, on their saved states (Appendix C ). The sharpest one compares a + b a+b with its sign-flipped twin a − b a-b (Table 5 ). In both studies a + b a+b reads 0.09–0.13 better after loop 4 and 0.16–0.17 better after loop 3, on every one of the 24 templates. Here the needed sign is plus, so a general preference for differences, which is what bare addition showed, predicts the opposite. For a − c a-c against a + c a+c and b − c b-c against b + c b+c the needed sign is minus, so the same preference predicts the observed winners and the comparison cannot separate the two; b − c b-c also loses to b + c b+c after loop 3.
blocks.zh: 本分节中的分析是在两项研究之后进行的,即关于它们所节省的状态(附录C)。 最尖锐的将一个+b a +b 与它的标志相提并论的双子-b a-b(表5)相提并论。 在这两项研究中,a + b a +b 在24个模板中每个模板的循环4后读作0.09-0.13,在循环3后读作0.16-0.17。 这里需要的标志是加的,所以一般偏好差异,即赤裸裸的添加所显示的,预言相反. a-c a-c对一+c a-c和b-b-c对一+c a-c 需要的标志为负数,所以同样的偏好预测被观测到的胜者,比较不能将两者分开;b-b-c在循环3后也输给b+克.

blocks.en: Table 5: Sign-flipped twins at P1 (excess over each label’s copy ceiling; difference with 97.5% interval over families). Only the first row has a plus as the needed sign.
blocks.zh: 表5:在P1(每个标签的复制天花板过量;与家庭的间隔为97.5%)上签名的双胞胎。 只有第一行有附加作为需要的标志.

blocks.en: Against all 30 combinations of the digits other than the answer (which Ouro is about to write, and which reads +0.61 and +0.66), a + b a+b ranks first in Study 2, 0.061 [0.028, 0.093] ahead of the runner-up, and second in Study 1, 0.022 behind it (Figure 4 ). By the rule we fixed before this check, that weakens the claim that a + b a+b itself is held. The runner-up in both studies is a − c a-c . It is another route to a + b − c a+b-c , but it is also the kind of difference a general preference would favour, so we do not count it as evidence of computation.
blocks.zh: 相对于答案以外的所有30个位数组合(Ouro即将写出,并读出+0.61和+0.66), a + b a +b 排在研究 2 0.061 [0.028, 0.093] 领先于跑步者, 排在研究 1 0.022 后 (图 4. 根据我们在此核对之前确定的规则,这削弱了关于持有+b a +b本身的说法。 两项研究的起跑者为-c a-c. 这是通向+b-c a+b-c的另一种途径,但这也是一般偏爱的区别,因此我们不把它算作计算的证据。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Every mod-5 combination of the operands’ units digits at P1, after loop 4: excess over its own copy ceiling, with 97.5% intervals over families. Each colour is one line through the answer (answer + k × +\,k\,\times one copied number); the dark bar is that line’s two-number member ( a + b a+b , a − c a-c , b − c b-c ). Grey: combinations on no answer line. The answer digit and the copies are not shown.
blocks.zh: 图4:在P1循环4之后,每一次Mod-5组合的操作单位数位数:超过自己的复制机上限,比家庭间隔97.5%。 每个颜色通过答案为一行(回答+k××××,k\,\times one copy number;暗行为该行的双数成员(一个+b a+b,a-c a-c,b-c-). Grey:无答行上的组合. 答案数字和副本不显示。

blocks.en: The protocol’s last step tests mixtures of the output. On units digits, a + b a+b is the answer plus c c , so a state that mixes the answer it is about to write with a copy of c c could make a + b a+b readable. a + b a+b tops the line answer + k ​ c +\,kc by +0.075 [0.052, 0.098] in Study 2 and +0.048 [0.030, 0.066] in Study 1, but a calibrated null on Study 3’s items shows that generic mixing tops such a line too (Section 5.4 ); it also tops the other two-number combinations by 0.09–0.13. Such mixtures do exist: after loop 4, forms on the answer lines read 0.06–0.07 above forms on no answer line. The margin also survives the stricter baselines. Adding the answer digit already written changes nothing, and adding the carry and borrow, which Ouro does not see as tokens, lowers the Study 2 margin to +0.048 [0.023, 0.074]. On problems Ouro answers correctly it is +0.064 [0.037, 0.091], and resampling templates instead of families does not widen the loop-4 intervals.
blocks.zh: 协议的最后一步测试了输出的混合物. 在单位位数上,一个+b a+b是答案+c c,所以将它将要写入的答案与c c 的副本相混合的状态可以使一个+b a+b可读性. a + b a +b 在研究2中将行答+克 c + + ,克克 + 0.075 [0.052, 0.098] 和 + 0.048 [0.030, 0.066] 在研究1中将行答加上,但是对研究3项目进行的校正显示,一般混合上也具有这种行取(第5.4节);它还以0.09-0.13的相加上其他双数组合. 此类混合物确实存在:在循环4后,答案行的表格改为没有答案行的上方表格为0.06-0.07。 比值也高于更严格的基线。 加上答案数字已经写入了任何更改,并加上了载出和借出,而Ouro并不将载出和借出视为符号,将"研究2"的比值降低到+0.048 [0.023,0.074]. 关于Ouro问题的答案正确,是+0.064 [0.037,0.091],重印模板而不是家庭不会扩大循环-4间隔.

blocks.en: No probe label can separate “ a + b a+b was formed and the answer computed from it” from “the answer was formed and c c added back”: they are the same function of the digits. The timing does not help the first reading: after loop 1, a + b a+b and the answer digit read about equally (+0.16 each in Study 2), and after loop 2 the answer reads higher (+0.53 against +0.38). At the moment it is needed, then, a + b a+b is readable beyond what copies allow and beyond its sign-flipped twin, in two studies with different templates, and it tops its answer line by about as much as generic mixing does. Two questions remain. Every problem needed a + b a+b , so a fixed preference for sums at P1 would also explain the sign-flip result. And whether Ouro uses the value needs an intervention. Study 3 addresses both.
blocks.zh: 任何探测器标签都无法将“一个+b a +b已经形成,并且从中计算出答案”与“答案已经形成,c又加回”区分开来:它们是数字的相同功能。 时间对一读没有帮助:在回转1, a + b a +b 后,答案数字读取约等于(在"研究"2中每个字母为+0.16),在回转2后,答案读取更高(+0.53对+0.38). 因此,在目前需要的时候,一个+b a +b 的可读性超出了复制允许的,并且超出了其标志-fllipped twin,在两个研究中,有不同的模板,它以大约一般混合的一样多的解答线. 还剩两个问题。 每个问题都需要+b a +b ,所以P1对金额的固定偏好也会解释标志-flip结果. 而Ouro是否使用价值需要干预. 研究3既涉及两个问题。

blocks.en: 5.3 Study 3: swapping the operation, and patching
blocks.zh: 5.3 研究3:交换操作和补丁

blocks.en: Study 3 was pre-registered in two parts. Its 12 new templates come in two versions that differ only in the first step’s phrase: “gave her B B more stickers” gives a + b − c a+b-c , and “took B B of her stickers” gives a − b − c a-b-c . A plus family and its minus twin share names, tens digits and unit-digit combinations. Each version has 7,200 problems, and probes are trained and scored within a version. Let D + D_{+} be the excess of a + b a+b minus that of a − b a-b on plus problems, D − D_{-} the reverse on minus problems, and I = ( D + + D − ) / 2 I=(D_{+}+D_{-})/2 . A fixed preference for either sign adds the same amount to one D D and takes it from the other, so it cancels in I I ; we report it as F = ( D − − D + ) / 2 F=(D_{-}-D_{+})/2 . The label FOLLOWS required I ≥ 0.05 I\geq 0.05 at P1 after loop 4, with its interval above zero and both D D s positive.
blocks.zh: 研究3分两部分预先注册. 其12个新模板分为两个版本,只有第一步的短语不同: " 给她的B多贴一贴 " 表示+b-c a+b-c; " 给她的B多贴一贴 " 表示-b-c-b-c。 一个外加家族 和它的负双子股名 数十位数和单位数组合 每个版本都有7200个问题,探测器在一个版本内经过了训练和得分. 让 D + D + + + + + + + + + + 问题 + + 问题 + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +  对两个标志的固定偏好给一个DD增加相同的金额,从另一个DD取出,因此在I一中取消;我们报告为F=(D−-D+)/2 F=(D_{-)-D_{+}/ 2. 之后的标签要求P1在回路4后为I 0.05 I\geq 0.05,其间隔为0以上并同时为D正数。

blocks.en: All gates passed: accuracy after loop 4 was 0.67 on plus and 0.77 on minus problems, the copies at P0 read at 0.98–1.00 at their best state, and the bare sum digit at 1.00. The label is FOLLOWS (Table 6 ): I = + 0.157 I=+0.157 [0.141, 0.172], with 97.5% intervals that resample twin families together. On minus problems a − b a-b reads +0.27 and a + b a+b +0.08, nearly the mirror image of plus problems. The fixed preference is small and favours differences, F = + 0.032 F=+0.032 [0.012, 0.053], as bare addition suggested. The digit Ouro is about to write depends on the carry or borrow from the units, which is sign-specific, so a pre-registered stricter check adds the carry and borrow to the copy ceiling. With them, I I at P1 is +0.126 [0.107, 0.145], still well above the bar, and at P0, before the answer starts, it is − 0.013 -0.013 [ − 0.028 -0.028 , 0.002]: nothing sign-specific is readable there beyond the carry and borrow. The copy of b b reads only 0.77–0.81 there after loop 4 (0.66 in Study 1), so P0 is the weaker test. In both versions the needed form also tops the other forms on its answer line after loop 4, by +0.036 and +0.045, which generic mixing matches (Section 5.4 ). So the sign-flip result of Studies 1 and 2 is not a preference for sums at P1: the better-read sign is the one the problem needs. This still does not separate a first step formed before the answer from the answer with c c added back, since in both versions the needed form is the answer plus c c .

blocks.en: All four tests are NOT-USED (Table 7 ). At the end of loop 3 the answer patch moves the prediction to x ′ x^{\prime} ’s digit in 90% of pairs, so a 9-dimensional patch at P1 can steer the output. The a + b a+b patch does so in 1.7%, slightly less often than the a − b a-b patch, and under it Ouro keeps its own digit in 96–99% of pairs. With the answer held fixed, the a + b a+b patch hits 0.3%. The end-of-loop-2 tests are weak: there the answer patch hits only 33%, because loops 3 and 4 restore x x ’s own digit in about two thirds of pairs, which fits a state that is re-derived in each loop ( Wang & Reid, 2026 ) . Together the two parts say that at P1 the readable combination follows the operation, but Ouro does not read it there to write the units digit. By the end of loop 3, though, the answer is strongly readable, so an intact answer could override a weak a + b a+b component even if a + b a+b had been used to form it earlier; Section 5.4 tests this. Only P1 was patched. A pre-registered follow-up on the same problems looked earlier, at the period ending the sentence that gives b b (“Her friend gave her 13 more stickers.”), where a running total would sit. There the sign did not follow the operation ( I I at most +0.018 at any loop end, every upper bound at most 0.036; UNCLEAR by its rule, since no bound fell below 0.02), so its patching step was not run, and the answer was not readable at the end of the sentence that gives c c either.

blocks.en: Two further pre-registered studies address the weakest points above. The first repeats the patching on the same pairs in three ways that leave no formed answer to override a + b a+b (Table 8 ). A single patch at the end of loop 1, where a + b a+b and the answer read about equally, cannot be scored: loops 2–4 undo any patch made there, even one of the answer (hit 0.009). Clamping, which sets the component to the partner’s at the end of loops 1, 2 and 3, does not have that problem: clamping the answer moves the written digit in 91% of pairs, while clamping a + b a+b moves it to the partner’s digit in at most 4% of pairs, within 0.02 of the a − b a-b and random controls, and Ouro keeps its own digit in 90–97% of pairs. Both clamp tests are NOT-USED, including the equal-answer pairs, in which an a + b a+b patch cannot carry the partner’s answer. In the third test the answer’s component is first set to its family mean at the end of loop 3. Ouro then writes its own digit in only 31–32% of pairs, so the a + b a+b component left at P1 does not rebuild the answer, and the partner’s does not steer the digit: every condition, random included, hits the target at about chance (0.08–0.10). This test is weaker than the clamp. It has no positive control, and with the answer removed the output is largely scrambled, so a null there may reflect a disrupted state rather than an unused value.

Clamping将元件设定在一、二和三环的末端,它没有这个问题: 将答案按91%的对数移动出正数位数,而将一个+b a+b按最多4%的对数移动出正数位数位数,在-b a-b和随机控件的0.02以内,而Ouro则按90-97%的对数保留自己的正数位数位数. 两种夹口测试都不使用,包括等分答对,其中+b a+b补丁不能携带伴侣的答案. 在第三个测试中,答案的成分首先被设定为家庭平均值,在循环结束时 3个 Ouro随后只用31–32%的对数写出自己的数字,所以P1所留下的+b a+b组件不会重建答案,而合伙人也不引导数字:每个条件,随机包含,都以概率(0.08–0.10)来击中目标. 这个测试比夹子弱. 它没有正控,随着解答被移除,输出基本被打乱了,所以一个空会反映一个被打乱的状态而不是一个未使用的值.

blocks.en: The second study calibrates the protocol’s mixture tests. We built synthetic states on Study 3’s items with copies of a a , b b and c c , a strong answer code and no a ± b a\pm b term, plus one generic mixture of the four digits: products of random codes for every pair, or same-frequency products of periodic digit features, or a random one-layer network. The mixing strength was set so that the needed form reads about as well as in Ouro, and the note’s own probes then scored each world. Pairwise mixing tops the answer line by as much as Ouro does or more (mean margins +0.078 and +0.051 over six worlds each, against +0.036 and +0.045), so by the pre-registered rule the line test does not separate a held a ± b a\pm b from mixing. The reason is that the needed form is a function of two inputs, a a and b b , which pairwise mixing makes readable directly, while the other forms on its line need all three; in the Fourier worlds, answer ± 2 ​ c \pm 2c barely reads, as the outside objection predicted. The random network never made the needed form as readable as in Ouro, so it could not be calibrated. The same worlds give an operation-swap statistic I I of +0.09 on average and at most +0.14, against +0.157 in Ouro: the sign-following signal exceeds every null world, but mixing alone produces about half of it.

blocks.en: 5.5 Loop dynamics
blocks.zh: 5.5 循环动态

blocks.en: At P1, every combination of the numbers we checked reads better at the end of a loop than in its middle, including a + c a+c , which the problem never needs, while the copy of b b reads better in the middle. This is not an effect of normalization: Ouro normalizes the state it feeds into the next loop, but dividing each mid-loop state by its own size leaves the pattern unchanged. Within each loop, the second half of the layers makes combinations of the numbers readable. Unneeded ones then fade: a + c a+c peaks after loop 2 (+0.46) and falls to +0.09 by loop 4, while a + b a+b peaks after loop 3 (+0.45) and keeps +0.22. In Study 3 the needed form peaks after loop 3 on plus problems (+0.51) and after loop 2 on minus problems (+0.42).
blocks.zh: 在P1中,我们所检查的每个数字组合在循环的结尾读取比其中间更好,包括一个+c a+c,问题从来不需要,而bb的复制在中间读取更好. 这不是正常化的影响: Ouro将它反馈到下一个回路的状态正常化,但将每个中游状态除以自己的大小会让模式保持不变. 在每个环内,下半层使数字的组合可读. 不需要的再淡出:一个+c a+c的峰值在循环2后(+0.46)并被循环4降为+0.09,而一个+b a+b的峰值在循环3(+0.45)后并保持+0.22. 在研究3中,所需形式在循环3后(+0.51)和循环2后(+0.42)达到高峰。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 限制

blocks.en: The probing results rest on two models of about 1.5B parameters, one looped and one standard; the computation studies use Ouro alone. The problems take two closely related forms ( a ± b − c a\pm b-c with two-digit numbers), read at a position where the gold answer is fed in. The minimal-pair test needs the other variants of a question. The full set of single-prompt decoders was tested on 77 distinct questions. With 5,249, the best single-prompt probe reaches 0.19 in Qwen and 0.36 in Ouro, and both are still rising, so probes trained on more questions may read much more of the digit; the claim is that single-prompt readability stays far below presence at the data sizes tested, not that the digit cannot be read. Several earlier readings were revised by pre-registered follow-ups (Appendix C ); the text states each result as it now stands. Of the ten pre-registered probing studies, one was unscorable and two UNCLEAR, the many-question test was partial in Qwen and climbed in Ouro, and Study 2’s bar was set after Study 1’s near-miss. Study 3’s second patch point and its equal-answer pairs were added after its states were extracted, though before any analysis. The comparisons in Section 5.2 and the loop dynamics were run afterwards on the saved states, and some of them had their reading rules written down only after related numbers were known (Appendix C ). The computation signal is small, a − c a-c ’s lead cannot be separated from a preference for differences, and b − c b-c does not behave like a held partial result after loop 3. The patching tests one position and subspaces spanned by class means; a single patch at the end of loop 1 could not be scored, since later loops undo it. The mixing null covers three kinds of synthetic mixing on 64-dimensional states; one of them could not be calibrated, and real states may mix differently. An a + b a+b held at other positions, such as the question sentence, and read from there through attention, or held in a code outside those subspaces, would be missed, and the end-of-loop-2 tests are weak because later loops undo most patches made there.

blocks.en: 7 Related work
blocks.zh: 7 相关工作

blocks.en: Looped models. Huginn ( Geiping et al., 2025 ) and Ouro ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) are pretrained looped language models. In looped models, each layer of the repeated block settles into its own fixed point ( Blayney et al., 2026 ) , and lenses on outputs, attention and noise injection have been used to monitor their latent reasoning, Ouro’s included, without probes ( Olszowiec et al., 2026 ) . Ouro’s state is re-derived within each loop rather than carried across loops ( Wang & Reid, 2026 ) . Its GSM8K accuracy peaks near its training depth and falls sharply with more loops ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , and the support for reference answers falls with more loops in most model-task conditions ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . Reusing one key-value cache slot across loop steps drops Ouro’s accuracy from 78% to 0.2% while Huginn is unaffected ( Schwethelm et al., 2026b , Table 4) . Huang et al. (2026) read this as Huginn’s states approaching fixed points while Ouro’s do not, which fits a state that is re-derived in each loop.
blocks.zh: 循环模型。 Huginn (Geiping等, 2025年)和Ouro (Zhu等, 2025年)是预先训练的循环语言模型. 在被环绕的模型中,每层被重复的块固定在自己的固定点上(Blayney等人,2026年),关于输出、注意力和噪声注入的镜头被用来监测其潜在的推理(Ouo),包括其中,没有探测器(Olszowiec等人,2026年)。 Ouro的状态是在每个循环内部重生,而不是跨循环(Wang & Reid, 2026). 其GSM8K精度峰值接近其训练深度并随着更多的回转而急剧下降(Yang等,2026年),在大多数模型任务条件下,对参考答案的支持会随着更多的回转而下降(Guo等,2026年). 使用一个跨循环步骤的键值缓存槽,Ouro的精度从78%降至0.2%,而Huginn则未受影响(Schwethelm等,2026b,表4)。 Huang等人(2026年)将此读作Huginn的状态接近了固定点而Ouo的状态没有,这符合每个循环中重生的状态.

blocks.en: Latent reasoning. In 116 models pretrained from scratch at equal total depth and small budgets, Schwethelm et al. (2026a) find no reasoning advantage from looping: scored by continuation loss, the non-looped model leads on reasoning primitives at nearly every budget, and reasoning-heavy tasks show no above-noise difference. They compare looped with unlooped models; we compare loop counts within one trained model. Lu et al. (2025) measured Huginn’s answer-only accuracy and applied a logit lens. Kirin (2026) probes Ouro for whether it will answer correctly, not for values. An unreviewed repository applies a logit lens to Ouro-1.4B-Thinking and finds only the final answer, never intermediate values ( mild-rgb, 2026 ) . In theory, a looped transformer can simulate T T chain-of-thought steps in T T loops ( Saunshi et al., 2025 ) . Models trained to drop written steps can compute intermediates internally ( Deng et al., 2024 ; Hao et al., 2025 ) . In multi-step arithmetic, models compute sub-answers while writing their chain of thought rather than before it ( Kudo et al., 2024 ) ; implicit multi-step arithmetic in models trained from scratch relies on shortcuts ( Lin et al., 2025 ) ; and discrete intermediate states have been read from hidden states ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . In standard models, the first hop of a two-hop question is often resolved latently but the full chain less reliably ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Biran et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 潜质推理. 在116个模型中,从头到尾,在同等的全深度和小预算上,施韦瑟尔姆等(2026年a)发现循环没有推理优势:被持续损失所打分,而非自制模型几乎在每个预算上都领先推理原始人,推理繁重的任务显示没有高于噪音的差异. 他们比较了循环模型和未用厕所的模型;我们比较了一个训练有素的模型中的循环计数。 吕等 (2025)测量了胡金恩的只答精度,并应用了对数镜头. Kirin (2026)调查了Ouro是否正确回答,而不是价值. 一个未经审查的寄存器对Ouro-1.4B-Thinking应用了logit透镜,只找到最后的答案,从未找到中间值(温和的rgb,2026). 在理论上,环绕式变压器可以模拟T T回路中T链-思维步骤(Saunshi等,2025.). 受过跳出书面步骤训练的模型可以在内部计算中间体(Deng等,2024;Hao等,2025.). 在多步算法中,模型在写出其思维链而不是在它之前时会计算出子答案(Kudo等,2024;从零开始训练的模型中隐含多步算法依赖于快捷方式(Lin等,2025;离散中间状态是从隐藏状态读取(Chen等,2024. 在标准模型中,双跳问题的第一个跳出往往被潜在地解决,但整个链条的可靠性较低(Yang等,2024;Biran等,2024)。

blocks.en: Probing and its limits. Our analysis builds on control tasks and selectivity ( Hewitt & Liang, 2019 ) and on difference-in-means probing ( Marks & Tegmark, 2023 ) . Our learning curves are close in spirit to information-theoretic and minimum-description-length probing, which ask how much data or code a probe needs rather than only how accurate it ends up ( Voita & Titov, 2020 ; Pimentel et al., 2020 ) ; contrast-consistent search also works with paired prompts, subtracting a separate mean from each side of the pairs ( Burns et al., 2023 ) . Park et al. (2024) define concept directions from counterfactual pairs, as our minimal pairs do, and argue that reading them needs a non-Euclidean inner product. A few rogue dimensions can dominate similarity measures on transformer states ( Timkey & van Schijndel, 2021 ) ; our overlap measurements are a probing-level case, in which the variation between questions is largest along the directions any change at a token takes. Probing critiques ( Belinkov, 2022 ) stress that a readable property need not be used ( Ravichander et al., 2021 ; Elazar et al., 2021 ) ; at P1, Ouro’s a + b a+b is a case of it. A probe can also fail because of the target’s framing rather than its absence ( Nanda et al., 2023b ) , a converse case to ours. Interchange interventions and alignment search ( Geiger et al., 2021 ; Geiger et al., 2024 ) and causal mediation with counterfactual inputs ( Vig et al., 2020 ; Stolfo et al., 2023 ) test whether a variable is used. Our patch is an interchange intervention on a subspace spanned by class means rather than one found by alignment search; subspace patches can mislead when they act through dormant directions ( Makelov et al., 2024 ) , a risk that bears on positive results more than on a null like ours. Stolfo et al. (2023) find operand information carried by attention to the last token of bare arithmetic queries, and Hanna et al. (2023) patch between prompts that differ in a year. Contrast vectors from paired stimuli are also the basis of representation engineering ( Zou et al., 2023 ) . Readouts that decode states with learned per-layer translators and the model’s own unembedding, as the tuned lens does ( Belrose et al., 2023 ) , or through the model’s own forward pass, as Patchscopes does ( Ghandeharioun et al., 2024 ) , are alternatives to the logit lens used on looped models. Yu (2024) reports that last-token probes rarely detect intermediate steps in prompted implicit reasoning; we probe the same position, but add minimal pairs and controls for copies of the inputs. To our knowledge, no earlier work reads a copied token at a summary position with minimal pairs while a standard probe fails, or combines a copy ceiling, a prime modulus, every combination of the inputs and sign-flipped twins to test a computed value. Ye et al. (2025) read which quantities a problem needs at the question’s end, and values after each solution sentence, in models trained from scratch on synthetic problems.
blocks.zh: 探取及其所限. 我们的分析基于控制任务和选择性(Hewitt & Liang, 2019年)和不同含义的检测(Marks & Tegmark, 2023年). 我们的学习曲线在精神上接近于信息理论和最小描述长度的验证,它询问探针需要多少数据或代码,而不是它最终的准确程度(Voita & Titov, 2020; Pimentel等, 2020; 对比-相容性搜索也与对等的提示相配合,从对等的两边分别减去一个平均值(Burns等, 2023). 朴来等. (2024)从反事实对来定义概念方向,就像我们最小的对一样,并主张读取它们需要非欧克利得内产. 几个无赖维度可以主导变速器状态上的类似度量(Timkey & van Schijndel, 2021); 我们的重叠度量是一个测试级的例, 其中问题之间的相差最大, 调查批评(Belinkov, 2022年)强调不需要使用可读财产(Ravichander等, 2021年;Elazar等, 2021年;在P1, Ouro's a + b) a+b就是这种情况。 探测器也可能因为目标的布局而非其缺失而失败(Nanda等人,2023年b),这与我们的情况相反。 交流干预和对齐搜索(Geiger等人,2021年;Geiger等人,2024年)和有反事实投入的因果调解(Vig等人,2020年;Stolfo等人,2023年)检验变量是否被使用. 我们的补丁是一个通过类手段跨越的子空间的交换干预,而不是通过对齐搜索找到的;子空间补丁通过休眠方向(Makelov等,2024年)行事时会误导,这种风险比我们这样的一无所有者更能产生积极的结果。 Stolfo等人(2023年)发现通过注意光算查询的最后一个符号所携带的操作信息,而Hanna等人(2023年)则发现一年中不同提示之间的补丁. 配对刺激产生的对比矢量也是代表工程的基础(Zou等,2023.). 解码器的读取器显示每个层都有精通的翻译和模型本身的不嵌入,如调制镜头(Belrose等人,2023年),或通过模型自己的前传,如Patchscopes(Ghandeharioun等人,2024年),是循环模型中使用的登录镜头的替代品. Yu (2024)报道说,最后的托肯探测器很少在被诱发的隐含推理中检测出中间步骤;我们探测到相同位置,但为输入的复制件添加了最小的对和控件. 据我们所知,在标准探测器失败时,没有早期的作品在简易位置读取一个复制的代号,或者结合一个复制天花板,一个质地模具,每个输入物和被标记的双胞胎组合来测试一个计算值. Ye等人(2025年)读到一个问题在问题结束时需要的数量,以及每个解决方案句子之后的数值,从头到尾接受合成问题培训的模型。

blocks.en: Number representations. Zhu et al. (2024) find number values linearly encoded. Pretrained models also carry periodic number features, with periods such as 2, 5 and 10, and use them in addition ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Kantamneni & Tegmark, 2025 ) , as small models do in modular addition ( Nanda et al., 2023a ) . Arithmetic in LLMs can also come from a bag of heuristics rather than one algorithm ( Nikankin et al., 2025 ) , which fits the generic mixing we see in bare addition, and small transformers trained on addition build explicit carry features ( Quirke & Barez, 2024 ) , one reason the copy baseline is also given the carry and borrow.
blocks.zh: 数量表示。 Zhu等人(2024年)找到线性编码的数字值. 预训型号还带有周期性编号特征,有2个,5个和10个期等,并另外使用(周等,2024;Kantamnei & Tegmark,2025),如小型号在模块外加(Nanda等,2023a). LLMs中的Arithmetic也可以出自一包heuristics而不是一包算法(Nikankin等,2025年),这个算法符合我们赤裸裸地看到的一般混合,另外在添加上训练出的小变压器会构建出明显的承载特性(Quirke & Barez,2024年),这也是复制基准也得到承载和取出的原因之一.

blocks.en: Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 可复制性

blocks.en: The repository holds the code, frozen hashes, analysis outputs and decision rules for every experiment here, including per-item results for the post-hoc comparisons. Every pre-registration was committed before its run; those of the ten probing studies (the intermediate value at the last prompt token, the Qwen replication, the robustness study, which includes Qwen’s many-question curve, Ouro’s many-question study, the linear-response study, Studies 1–3, the running-total follow-up and the early patching; Sections 3.1 , 3.2 , 3.3 , 5.1 , 5.3 and 5.4 ) and of the synthetic mixing null, and their amendments, were also pushed to GitHub before their runs or analysis, which gives them an external timestamp. Each experiment’s document records its predictions, its results, and every change made before data.
blocks.zh: 存储库持有代码,被冻结的散列,分析输出和决定规则,用于这里的每一个实验,包括用于后期比较的每个项目结果. 每一个预先登记都是在运行前完成的;10个测试研究(在最后一个即期符号的中间值,Quen复制,强健性研究,包括Quen的多问题曲线,Ouro的多问题研究,线性反应研究,1-3研究,跑起的全程跟踪和早期补丁;第3.1,3.2,3.3, 5.1, 5.3和5.4节)和合成混合无效及其修正,在运行或分析之前被推入了GitHub,这给了他们一个外部时间戳. 每个实验的文件记录了它的预测,结果,以及数据之前的每一个变化.

blocks.en: On the first 200 GSM8K test problems (Figure 5 ), Ouro answers 6.5%, 20.0%, 22.5% and 23.0% after loops 1 to 4. The gain over four loops is +16.5 points, 95% CI [10.5, 22.5] by paired bootstrap; from loop 2 to loop 4 it is +3.0 [ − 1.5 -1.5 , +7.5]. Huginn-3.5B reaches 5.5% at 32 recurrences, inside the interval around Lu et al. ’s 4.9%, which checks our harness against a published number. We do not require a newline after the answer, because Huginn’s tokenizer merges line breaks; an earlier scorer that required one gave Huginn 0%.
blocks.zh: 在前200个GSM8K测试问题(图5)上,Ouro答出6.5%,20.0%,22.5%和23.0%的循环1至4后. 4个回路的增益为+16.5分,95%为CI [10.5,22.5]用对接的靴子;从回路2到回路4是+3.0 [−1.5-1.5,+7.5]. Hugin-3.5B在32次复发时达到5.5%, 因为Huginn的标语器会合并分行符;

blocks.en: The loop-1-to-2 step is not specific to arithmetic. The Ouro paper’s own base-model table shows the same shape on every benchmark it reports, including HellaSwag (55.2, 71.2, 74.3 at loops 1, 2, 4) and MMLU (41.2, 60.4, 67.5) ( Zhu et al., 2025 , Table 10) . Ouro’s training loss covers the output of every loop ( Zhu et al., 2025 , Eq. 4) , and Schwethelm et al. (2026b) exclude exits after a single loop as consistent with Ouro’s exit behaviour, so part of the step may reflect a weak first exit.
blocks.zh: 循环-1至2步不特指算术. Ouro报自己的基建模型表显示其报告的每个基准的形状相同,包括HelaSwag(55.2,71.2,74.3,循环1,2,4)和MMLU(41.2,60.4,67.5)(Zhu等人,2025年,表10)。 Ouro的训练损失涵盖了每个回路(Zhu等,2025,Eq. 4)的输出,而Schwethelm等(2026b)则按照Ouo的出站行为,在一次回路后排除出站,因此部分出站步骤可能反映出站疲弱的第一出站.

blocks.en: On GSM-Symbolic ( Mirzadeh et al., 2024 ) , where names and numbers of 100 GSM8K problems are resampled, accuracy on 500 variants rises from 2.8% to 9.2% (+6.4 points [3.4, 10.0], most of it at loop 2), against 10.0% to 18.0% on their 100 originals. A larger set of 4,200 variants from 84 templates has the same shape at a lower level (3.0% to 7.0%). Recall of the published problems is one explanation of the gap, but resampling also changes the numbers’ size and difficulty, so the gap is at most a memorization effect. The pre-registered bar for the variant gain was half the GSM8K gain (8.25 points); it fell short and was labelled UNCLEAR. For scale, with generated reasoning Ouro scores about 43% after one loop and 75–77% after two to four ( Yang et al., 2026 , Fig. 1) , and 78.9% after four in the Ouro paper.
blocks.zh: 在GSM-Symbolic上(Mirzadeh等,2024年),100个GSM8K问题的名称和数字被重印后,500个变体的精度从2.8%上升到9.2%(+6.4分[3.4,10.0分],其中大部分在回转2上,而其100个正本的精度从10.0到18.0%. 84个模板的4,200个变体的较大组合在较低水平(3.0%至7.0%)的形状相同. 复述已公布的问题是对差距的一个解释,但再作说明也会改变数字的大小和难度,因此差距最多只能是一种记忆效应. 预先登记的变种收益栏为GSM8K增益的一半(8.25分);该栏落空并被标为UNCLEAR. 就规模而言,Ouo在1个循环之后得分约为43%,在2至4个循环之后得分约为75-77 %(Yang等,2026年,图1),在Ouo论文中得分约为4个。

blocks.en: The minimal-pair probe already reads the digit at 0.87–0.92 from a quarter of the training templates. Against their own shuffled-label baselines, the colour word and the number varied in the added sentence have overlaps of 0.53–0.83 and 0.85–1.13 of the baseline in Ouro. In Qwen both are at about their baseline, except at the final layer, where the colour becomes readable to the standard probe (0.62–0.70) while the digit stays at 0.15–0.18. In a profile over all 29 depths of Qwen at the last token, the minimal-pair probe dips in the middle of the network (0.58–0.63 at layers 18–20) before it recovers to about 0.90. The top within-family residual directions have a higher overlap than the digit’s subspace (15–23 in Ouro).
blocks.zh: 最小平面探测器已经从四分之一的训练模板中读取了0.87–0.92的数字. 对照它们自己的被打乱的标签基线,所添加的句子中的颜色词和数字各不相同,Ouro的基线重叠为0.53-0.83和0.85-1.13. 在Quen中,两者都接近基线,但最后一层除外,该层的颜色可以读取标准探测器(0.62–0.70),而数字则停留在0.15–0.18. 在最后一个标语处昆文所有29个深处的剖面图中,最小平板探测器在网络中段(18-20层为0.58–0.63分)被浸入后恢复到约0.90分. 家族内部残留方向的顶端重叠率高于数字子空间(Ouro为15–23).

blocks.en: Linear response at the varied token. A pre-registered study took 24 of the questions, one per template, with their original digit and the same prompt, and measured by finite differences how the last prompt token’s state responds to small changes of the digit’s input embedding (step 0.02 times the median embedding norm). The squared gain along directions in which word embeddings differ is 1.16–1.28 times that along random directions in Qwen (layers 7–28) and 1.36–1.50 in Ouro (loop ends), against the 3 that would have counted as tuned to token directions; we had predicted tuned. Along digit-difference directions it is 2.7–8.5 and 4.4–5.0 times the word-direction gain. The response is linear only locally: for the full word swap, the linear prediction is orthogonal to the actual change ( cos ≈ 0 \cos\approx 0 ) and 4.5–15 times too small, while the full-size noise acts roughly linearly ( cos \cos 0.38–0.68). Per unit input, a word swap changes the last token 10–25 (Qwen) and 38–373 (Ouro) times more in squared size than the noise, and a digit swap 0.12–0.94 and 0.23–0.36 times as much as a digit-to-word swap. Causal tracing corrupts inputs by adding Gaussian noise to token embeddings ( Meng et al., 2022 ) , and Zhang & Nanda (2024) recommend replacing tokens instead; here, noise of a token embedding’s size barely reaches the summary position, while a token swap does.
blocks.zh: 各种符号的线性响应 。 预先登记的一项研究收集了24个问题,每个模板一个,其原始数字和同样的快取,并以有限的差异来衡量最后一个快取符号的状态如何响应数字输入嵌入的小变化(步骤为中位嵌入规范的0.02倍). 嵌入词不同方向的平方增益是Quen(7-28层)和Ouro(Loop端)随机方向的1.16至1.28倍,而3则算作按符号方向调取;我们预测了调取。 沿着数字-偏差方向,是字向收益的2.7-8.5和4.4-5.0倍。 反应只有局部的线性:对于整词互换,线性预测与实际变化是正向的(cos ≈ 0\cos\相差为0)和4.5–15倍太小,而全相差的噪声大约是线性(cos 0.38–0.68). 每个单位输入,一个单词互换会改变最后一个符号10–25(Quen)和38–373(Wero)的平方大小比噪声多出两倍,一个数字互换会是数字互换会0.12–0.94和0.23–0.36. Causal tracking通过将高斯噪音添加到符号嵌入(Meng等,2022年)而腐蚀了输入;而张和南达(2024年)则建议取而代之;在这里,一个符号嵌入大小的噪声几乎没有达到汇总位置,而一个符号交换则确实如此.

blocks.en: “Pre-registered”: thresholds and labels were frozen in a commit before the run. “Rule before running”: a post-hoc analysis whose reading rule was written down before its result was seen. “Exploratory”: decision rule fixed in code before the data, without a frozen pre-registration.
blocks.zh: “预先登记”:在逃难前,在一次行动中冻结了门槛和标签。 “运行前规则”:一项事后分析,其阅读规则在看到结果之前就被写下。 “探索性”:在数据之前按代码确定的决定规则,不作冻结的预先登记。
